title: File:Market vendors gathering on Pike Place, ca. 1907 - DPLA - f62ac740d22b6ca81f281666c4c52882 (page 1).jpg
desc: Seattle's Pike Place Market first opened in 1907 with humble beginnings as a group of farmers' carts at 1st and Pike.
